A '''grasper jaw''',<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> '''grasping jaw''',<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> or '''grasping mandible''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component.<ref name="Freedom">{{WEGCite|story=The Heat of Freedom|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> They were a common feature of the [[F1 exploration droid]]. As the droid was modeled after [[Canine/Legends|canine]] [[Species/Legends|species]], it featured a grasping jaw located in its head. It was designed to be able to hold an object without crushing it, and the droid was able to use the jaw to move incapacitated [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] out of danger. The presence of the grasper jaw, coupled with the droid's extensive [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] capabilities, limited the F1 to produce verbal communication in a narrow range of warning sounds.<ref name="GG8" /> The [[E3 Companion Droid]] was also fitted with a grasper jaw.<ref name="WHSV" />
